### Tools

| Tool | What it does | Read-only | Destructive | Posture |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `get_presentation` | Read the complete app-authorized presentation, including slide text and structure, for example presentationId=deck-fixture. | yes | no | auto |
| `get_page` | Read a slide page by presentationId and pageObjectId, for example deck-fixture and slide-fixture. | yes | no | auto |
| `get_thumbnail` | Get the temporary thumbnail URL for a slide. The URL is returned, not downloaded. | yes | no | auto |
| `create_presentation` | Create a blank presentation with title="Quarterly review". | no | no | ask |
| `create_slide` | Create a slide with a caller-selected objectId, for example new\_slide, and predefinedLayout="BLANK". | no | no | ask |
| `insert_text` | Insert text into an existing shape objectId at insertionIndex=0, for example text="Quarterly review". | no | no | ask |
| `replace_text` | Replace matching text across slides, for example containsText.text="PLACEHOLDER". | no | yes | deny |
| `delete_object` | Delete a slide or page element by objectId, for example slide-fixture. This is destructive. | no | yes | deny |
| `duplicate_object` | Duplicate a slide or shape by objectId, for example slide-fixture. | no | no | ask |
